_comment: Copy to systems.json (gitignored) or point SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE at it. One entry per ABAP system (destination); tools take a `destination` argument naming one of these keys. Mark one entry with "default": true to use it when destination is omitted. Optional per-entry gitUser/gitPassword supply abapGit credentials so they never pass through the model. Optional per-entry "policy" block: readOnly, deniedTools (globs), allowFreeSql, deniedTables (globs), allowedPackages (globs, closed), allowedTransports (globs, no new transports). MCP_READ_ONLY=1 makes every destination read-only. Optional per-entry "tls": ca (extra CA bundle), cert+key or pfx+passphrase (client certificate).
